Subject: Cash fee collection without a valid receipt - Kaveri

I am writing as a current student of Kaveri College of Engineering (B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering, 2025-26). Although the college's notice says all payments must be made online, the hostel office at Kaveri College of Engineering collected Rs. 73,900 in cash for mess charges. No receipt was given and the amount was not reflected in the portal. Several students have faced the same problem but are afraid to complain. I met the Principal on 2025-10-10 and submitted a written representation; no acknowledgement was given. I am afraid to give my full name because my internal marks are still pending. I request AICTE to verify the fee notification and direct the college to issue a proper receipt. The above facts are stated on the basis of records available with the complainant and may be verified from the college's files.

Complainant reference: REF/2026/000
Yours sincerely,
Dr. A. S. Kulkarni
B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering, Kaveri College of Engineering
